python3 -c  import re,subprocess R='/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin'; REV='13a9e9e1f7ca3b95f2cc11f24f69d0d92a21a8a5' def show(p):     r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',R,'show',REV+':'+p],capture_output=True,text=True)     return r.stdout if r.returncode==0 else None skill=show('SKILL.md') craft=skill.split('## Queue-drain craft (',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0] blocks=re.split(r'(?m)^- \*\*',craft)[1:] REF=re.compile(r'((?:corpus|plans|tools)/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+)(?::(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?)?') ok=0 for b in blocks:     refs=REF.findall(b); good=bool(refs)     for name,first,last in refs:         body=show(name)         if body is None: good=False; break         n=len(body.splitlines()); s=int(first or 1); e=int(last or first or 1)         if not (1<=s<=e<=n): good=False; break     ok+=good print('citation_resolved_rules %d/%d' % (ok,len(blocks)))
